s.how: Tip 200g salted mixed nuts and 100g beef jerky into a big bowl and toss together. Put a small bowl of 100g mints beside it and set both out before the opening credits.

s.note: Rusty, the best mate with the bad ideas
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once, and toss with chicken salt. Whisk gravy powder into 300ml boiling water until smooth and serve on the side for dipping.

m.note: waiting by the phone for the ransom call
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough onto a large oiled tray, spread with pizza sauce and top with 200g grated mozzarella and 100g sliced pepperoni. Bake at 240C for 12 minutes until the base is crisp.

w.note: the cookie fortune Miss Crock sits on
w.how: Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar, add 1 egg, then mix in 220g self-raising flour and 150g chocolate chips. Roll 12 balls, flatten slightly and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden at the edges.

d.how: Chill 1L full cream milk until very cold and pour into 4 tall glasses. Serve with the cookies so everyone can dunk, and keep the rest of the bottle in the fridge for refills.
